method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; transparent_background=true; copied native PNG bytes without cropping, resizing, alpha manipulation, or code-based image editing.
actual_dimensions_note: The built-in tool returned native 1254×1254 images. They were preserved without upscaling.
visual_check: Viewed each generated file. Correct team people counts 2/3/6; furniture/chairs/bookcases/associated props retained; no rugs, office floor, background, labels or dashboard UI. Camera/style/relative arrangement preserved as an ImageGen extraction rendition; no claim of pixel-identical extraction.

artifacts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: crisp transparent PNG component for a software-company office scene.
Input image: the attached local source is the edit target. Extract only the specified departmental furniture-and-people cluster. Preserve its exact elevated orthographic/isometric camera, soft polished 2.5D illustrated rendering, faces, clothing, chair positions, wood furniture, material colors, object scale relationships, lighting and relative arrangement. Remove everything outside the cluster. Produce a sharp high-resolution image, ideally 1536 x 1536 pixels, centered with tight transparent padding and every complete object safely inside the canvas.
Background must be genuinely transparent with an alpha channel. NO colored rug, NO floor tile, NO solid ground/platform/base, NO windows/walls/environment, NO other teams, NO labels, NO dashboard controls/UI, NO text, NO watermark. Retain only the specified people, their desks, chairs, bookcase/cabinet and directly associated small props/plants. Keep monitor displays as abstract unobtrusive screen content without readable text. Do not redesign the cluster or change the perspective.
Target: the TWO-person Data & AI cluster in the BOTTOM ROW, SECOND zone from the LEFT, originally on the CYAN/TEAL rug around x=620,y=670. Include exactly the seated short-dark-haired man wearing teal on the left and the long-dark-haired woman wearing light/teal clothing on the right, their opposing wooden workstation with monitors and central divider, two office chairs, desk mugs/books/plants, and the small white bookcase with books and potted plants directly behind this cluster. Preserve this exact two-person cluster. Remove its cyan rug and every surrounding office/environment object.
